query: List all the tables in the database.
sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public';

query: What is the schema of the vessels table?
sql: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'vessels';
SELECT name, vessel_type FROM vessels WHERE vessel_type ILIKE '%schooner%' LIMIT 10

query: provide all the details of the vessel named FARMER
sql: SELECT * FROM vessels WHERE name = 'FARMER' LIMIT 25

query: Which captain sailed the vessel named ANNIE?
sql: SELECT T2.name FROM vessels AS T1 JOIN crew AS T2 ON T1.vessel_id = T2.vessel_id WHERE T1.name = 'ANNIE' AND T2.position = 'Captain' LIMIT 25

query: How many voyages did each vessel complete?
sql: SELECT T1.name, count(T2.voyage_id) AS number_of_voyages FROM vessels AS T1 JOIN voyages AS T2 ON T1.vessel_id = T2.vessel_id GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY number_of_voyages DESC
